uncertainty.distribution: Independent standard normals; deterministic seeded draws, no clipping
uncertainty.position_sd_mm: uncertainty_level * 100 mm, including zero nominal coordinates
uncertainty.correlation: Identity between the 12 latent variables; all vertices of one mask and all finite source nodes share their rigid position perturbation
uncertainty.evidence: Synthetic sensitivity assumptions, not empirical tolerances or calibrated uncertainty

selection: Within each fixed forward-call budget, minimize maximum training constraint violation first, then nominal CV or E[CV]+lambda*population SD[CV]. Fixed random scenarios reused across every robust candidate. Nominal scenario included in robust training.
holdout_policy: Training RNG seed 10000+repeat; holdout RNG seed 90000+repeat, generated after both selected designs are frozen. Common random numbers between methods and levels. No holdout-based selection.

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% conditional Monte Carlo intervals, paired within each repeat

claims: Implementation and synthetic sensitivity only. No manufacturing release, Mo thresholds, Bayesian optimizer reproduction, global optimality, or empirical reliability claim.
